response.text: The `tcp_chat` repository provides a multi-client chat system designed for users who need a lightweight, Python-based messaging setup. It includes a dedicated server that manages unique user nicknames and broadcasts messages, alongside a command-line client for real-time interaction. Powered by a custom line protocol with length-prefixed frames, the system also features a complete test suite using pytest to ensure reliable message delivery across connected clients.
